summary: Access tokens expire after 1 year by default. For Authorization code integrations, allowlist cross-site origins in the platform settings file with CORS_ORIGIN_ALLOW_ALL and CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGIN_REGEXES.
questions: What is the default expiration of an AAP access token?
How do I allow CORS origins for an OAuth application?
CORS error when external app requests a token from AAP

answer_card.title: Allowlist origins for OAuth integrations
answer_card.answer_md:
Add to the local Ansible Automation Platform settings file:
```python
CORS_ORIGIN_ALLOW_ALL = True
CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGIN_REGEXES = [
    r"http://www.example.com*",
]
```
List each application that needs tokens. Access tokens expire after **1 year** by default.
